text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: You, mortal, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Then declare to it all its abominable deeds.
text_cn: “人子，你应开庭裁判这座流人血的城，叫她知道自己的丑恶。

text_en: You shall say, Thus says the Lord God : A city! Shedding blood within itself; its time has come; making its idols, defiling itself.
text_cn: 你应说：吾主上主这样说：那流人血，使时辰迫近，制造偶像，自染不洁的城，是有祸的！

text_en: You have become guilty by the blood that you have shed, and defiled by the idols that you have made; you have brought your day near, the appointed time of your years has come. Therefore I have made you a disgrace before the nations, and a mockery to all the countries.
text_cn: 因你倾流人血，自负血债；因你制造偶像，自染不洁，致使你的日子已近，你的年限已到；为此，我要使你成为万民所侮辱，万邦所耻笑的对象。

text_en: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
text_cn: 那离你近，离你远的，都要耻笑你为一恶名多乱的城。

text_en: The princes of Israel in you, everyone according to his power, have been bent on shedding blood.
text_cn: 看，以色列的首领，在你中间各逞其能，倾流人的血。

text_en: Father and mother are treated with contempt in you; the alien residing within you suffers extortion; the orphan and the widow are wronged in you.
text_cn: 在你中间有人轻视父母，在你中间有人压迫外方人，在你中间也有人欺压孤儿寡妇。

text_en: You have despised my holy things, and profaned my sabbaths.
text_cn: 你藐视了我的圣物，亵渎了我的安息日。

text_en: In you are those who slander to shed blood, those in you who eat upon the mountains, who commit lewdness in your midst.
text_cn: 在你中间有人诽谤，好倾流人血。在你中间有人到山上吃祭物，在你中间有人行淫乱。

text_en: In you they uncover their fathers’ nakedness; in you they violate women in their menstrual periods.
text_cn: 在你中间有人揭开父亲的下体，在你中间有人玷污行经不洁的妇女。

text_en: One commits abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another lewdly defiles his daughter-in-law; another in you defiles his sister, his father’s daughter.
text_cn: 在你中间有人同邻人的妻子行丑恶之事，有人奸污自己的儿媳，有人玷辱自己的姊妹，即父亲的女儿。

text_en: In you, they take bribes to shed blood; you take both advance interest and accrued interest, and make gain of your neighbors by extortion; and you have forgotten me, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 在你中间有人接受贿赂，以倾流人血。你收息金，放重利，用强力剥削你的近人，而你竟忘了我 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: See, I strike my hands together at the dishonest gain you have made, and at the blood that has been shed within you.
text_cn: 看，对你所放的重利，对在你中间所流的血债，我要鼓掌。

text_en: Can your courage endure, or can your hands remain strong in the days when I shall deal with you? I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.
text_cn: 在我与你算账的那天，难道你的心还能忍受，你的手还能坚强？我，上主言出必行。

text_en: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the countries, and I will purge your filthiness out of you.
text_cn: 我要将你驱逐在异民中，将你散布在各地，消除你的污秽。

text_en: And I shall be profaned through you in the sight of the nations; and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 以后在异民眼前，我必再使你做我的产业：如此你要承认我是上主。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, the house of Israel has become dross to me; all of them, silver, bronze, tin, iron, and lead. In the smelter they have become dross.
text_cn: “人子，以色列家族对我好像是渣滓，他们成了炉中的铜、锡、铁和铝，他们都成了银渣。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 因此吾主上主这样说：因为你们都成了渣滓，为此，看，我必将你们聚集在耶路撒冷，

text_en: As one gathers silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into a smelter, to blow the fire upon them in order to melt them; so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will put you in and melt you.
text_cn: 如把银、铜、铁、铅和锡聚集在炼炉中，在上面吹火，使它们镕化；照样，我也要把你们聚集在我的怒火和愤恨中，将你们抛在里面镕化。

text_en: I will gather you and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted within it.
text_cn: 我要聚集你们，在你们身上吹起我的怒火，使你们镕化在耶路撒冷；

text_en: As silver is melted in a smelter, so you shall be melted in it; and you shall know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath upon you.
text_cn: 就像银子在炼炉中镕化，你们也照样在城中镕化：如此，你们就承认我是上主，是我在你们身上发泄了怒火。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, say to it: You are a land that is not cleansed, not rained upon in the day of indignation.
text_cn: “人子，你应对此城说：你是一块在震怒之日无雨无水之地。

text_en: Its princes within it are like a roaring lion tearing the prey; they have devoured human lives; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows within it.
text_cn: 城中的王侯像撕裂猎物的吼狮，他们吞噬人民，抢夺财物和珍宝，增加了城中的寡妇。

text_en: Its priests have done violence to my teaching and have profaned my holy things; they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they taught the difference between the unclean and the clean, and they have disregarded my sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
text_cn: 城中司祭违犯我的法律，亵渎我的圣物，不分别圣与俗，不辨明洁与不洁，且掩目不顾我的安息日，致使我在他们中蒙受亵渎。

text_en: Its officials within it are like wolves tearing the prey, shedding blood, destroying lives to get dishonest gain.
text_cn: 城中的首长像撕裂猎物的豺狼，倾流人血，杀害人命，以图谋不义之财。

text_en: Its prophets have smeared whitewash on their behalf, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, “Thus says the Lord God , ” when the Lord has not spoken.
text_cn: 城中的先知还为他们掩饰罪过，所见的都是假异象，所说的都是欺诈的预言。他们说：吾主上主这样说，其实上主并没有说。

text_en: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery; they have oppressed the poor and needy, and have extorted from the alien without redress.
text_cn: 本地的人民蛮横强暴，劫夺抢掠，欺压穷苦贫困的人，迫害外方人，无法无天。

text_en: And I sought for anyone among them who would repair the wall and stand in the breach before me on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
text_cn: 我在他们中找寻一个能修理城墙的人，能在我面前为保护本地，站在缺口处，免得我去破坏那地方的人；但我没找到一个。

text_en: Therefore I have poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath; I have returned their conduct upon their heads, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 为此，我向他们发泄我的怒气，用我的怒火消灭他们，把他们的行为报复在他们头上 —— 吾主上主的断语。”
